name: Super Set
desc: Two exercises for opposing muscles with no rest.

name: Drop Set
desc: Reduce weight and continue until failure.

name: Giant Set
desc: 4 or more exercises for one muscle group consecutively.

name: Rest-Pause
desc: Short 15s rest within a single set to push further.

name: Negative Reps
desc: Slowly lowering the weight to maximize tension.

name: Pyramid Set
desc: Increasing weight and decreasing reps each set.
